definitions.explanation: A form of classical Japanese musical drama.
The capacity to do something well.

examples.japanese: {能|のう}を{鑑賞|かんしょう}する。
{能|のう}ある{鷹|たか}は{爪|つめ}を{隠|かく}す。
examples.english: A skilled hawk hides its talons. (Still waters run deep)

notes:
{能|のう} has two main meanings: Noh theater and ability.

NOH THEATER:
- {能楽|のうがく}: Noh theater (formal term)
- {能面|のうめん}: Noh mask
- {能舞台|のうぶたい}: Noh stage

ABILITY:
- {能力|のうりょく}: ability, capability
- {才能|さいのう}: talent
- {無能|むのう}: incompetent

PROVERB:
- {能|のう}ある{鷹|たか}は{爪|つめ}を{隠|かく}す: talented people don't show off
